newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to launch revised CPI index in February.
newsitem.headline: Greece to launch revised CPI index in February.

text.p: Greece will launch a revised consumer price index (CPI) in early February to bring its inflation measuring method into line with other European Union (EU) nations, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said.
The committee, set up to revise the CPI index in accordance with standard international practices and methodology applied in other EU countries, completed its work, said NSS in a statement.
Developments in January 1997 will be the first period covered by the new index, it said.
The revised CPI index takes into account the findings of family budget research conducted between October 1993 and September 1994. It said 1994 is the base year as opposed to 1988, currently.

The revised CPI index will sample private households in 17 cities, and the classification of goods and services will follow the international Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP), it said.

Apparel and footwear, entertainment, hotels, coffee and restaurants weightings in the new CPI index will be reduced but the communications, transportation, housing and health will be increased, it said.
